qrcode-generator 1.4.4 (npm: qrcode-generator, MIT) - vendored for the planter link QR code (stage A2).

- qrcode.js       : the unmodified file of the npm package (sha256 18ae399f81182bc9de916e9c77b195df20cc58d6f2d55a62b085a299f1bf1780).
- qrcode.esm.js   : this project's wrapper around the same text (adds a `module` and `export default`), used by src/new/planterQr.js.
- LICENSE.txt     : the MIT terms and the copyright line (the npm package has no LICENSE file; the terms are in its header and package.json).
Why this library: about 55 KB, no dependencies, no network, draws from the module matrix (the dashboard turns it into an SVG itself). It is loaded from this folder, never from a CDN.
Source: npm pack qrcode-generator@1.4.4 (https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator).
